newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood sees slightly higher Q3 sales.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood sees slightly higher Q3 sales.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc said it expects third quarter condoliated sales to be up less than one percent, to about $627 million from last year's $625.4 million.
The company, which produces manufactured housing and recreational vehicles, said it will release final sales and earnings for the third quarter ended January 26, 1997 in about four weeks.
The higher volume in the quarter just ended was driven by improved sales of recreational vehicles, which rose five percent to nearly $294 million, the company said.
Last year's third quarter RV revenues included sales of $11.5 million from a European operation which was sold in May 1996, the company said.
Excluding Europe from the comparison, RV sales grew 10 percent for the period, the company said.
All three RV divisions posted sales gains in the quarter, with the motor home division accounting for most of the RV increase, the company said.
